data.description: Serena Dubai: Where Mediterranean Charm Meets Modern Family Living

data.answer:
Serena Community Dubai is designed to offer residents a relaxed and peaceful lifestyle away from the city's hustle. The community is divided into three distinct sub-communities: Bella Casa, Casa Dora, and Casa Viva, each offering a variety of upscale villas and townhouses. Serena Villas Dubai comes in 2, 3, and 4-bedroom configurations, with stylish interiors and spacious layouts.

The community features vast open spaces, landscaped parks, playgrounds, and jogging tracks that promote a healthy and active lifestyle. Residents also enjoy access to swimming pools, fitness centers, and recreational facilities. The serene environment and modern amenities make Serena one of Dubai's best family-friendly residential communities.

Properties in Serena consist of elegantly designed villas and townhouses available in 2, 3, and 4-bedroom configurations. These spacious homes feature unique themed architecture and are surrounded by landscaped areas, creating a serene environment ideal for families. 

The 2-bedroom units range from 1,481 sq. ft. to 1,875 sq. ft., offering a spacious living room, fitted kitchen, maid’s room, and bedrooms with attached bathrooms. The units also include balconies that provide ample outdoor space. The 3-bedroom residences span between 2,155 sq. ft. and 3,014 sq. ft. These G+1 units boast a large living area, store room, powder room, and a maid’s room. 

The master bedroom on the first floor includes an attached bathroom, a built-in wardrobe, and a balcony. Other features include a parking area and a private garden, making them perfect for larger families. 

The 4-bedroom units, primarily located in the Casa Viva cluster, cover an average of 3,004 sq. ft. These homes have a maid’s room, a spacious living area, and a store room. Additional features include a garage, an in-house garden, and a dressing room in the master bedroom, offering residents a blend of luxury and practicality. 

Serena residents have access to community centers equipped with retail outlets, ATMs, swimming pools, gyms, cafes, and restaurants, further enhancing the quality of life in this vibrant community.

Popular Buildings in Serena

  • Bella Casa: The first phase of Serena, offering charming townhouses designed for modern family living with contemporary interiors.
  • Casa Dora: The second phase, featuring larger units with enhanced amenities, is perfect for growing families.
  • Casa Viva: The final phase, offering a blend of luxury villas and townhouses with access to top-tier facilities.

Each sub-community boasts premium amenities, including:

  • Landscaped parks
  • Swimming pools
  • Fitness centers

These features make Serena a desirable location for families and individuals seeking a premium lifestyle in Dubai.

Renting a Property in Serena

Searching for rental properties in Dubai? The rental market in Serena is highly sought after due to its luxurious facilities and premium lifestyle offerings. The average rental prices for villas in Serena are as follows:

  • 2-Bedroom Villas: Average rental price of AED 137,000 per year  
  • 3-Bedroom Villas: Average rental price of AED 169,000 per year  

Renting in Serena offers an excellent balance of luxury and comfort, with access to community amenities like landscaped parks, fitness centers, and swimming pools.

Buying a Property in Serena

Serena is an attractive investment opportunity for those looking to buy properties in Dubai, offering a perfect blend of luxury and modern living. Available options for sale include:

  • 2-Bedroom Townhouses: Starting from AED 1.3 million
  • 3-Bedroom Townhouses: Starting from AED 1.6 million
  • 2-Bedroom Villas: Average sales price of AED 2,046,000
  • 3-Bedroom Villas: Average sales price of AED 2,705,000

These Serena Dubai properties offer spacious interiors, private gardens, and luxurious facilities. The Serena Dubai properties floor plans accommodate various living styles, making them ideal for both families and investors seeking a premium lifestyle in Dubai.

Living in Serena Dubai offers a balanced lifestyle where luxury meets tranquility. Residents enjoy access to modern facilities, beautifully landscaped parks, and family-friendly amenities. Serena community is known for its tight-knit community feel, where neighbors bond through various events and activities. With schools, supermarkets, dining options, and recreational spaces all within easy reach, life in Serena is convenient and fulfilling.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Serena

Serena offers ample parking spaces for residents, with each villa or townhouse having dedicated parking spots. Public transportation options are somewhat limited in the area, but the nearest bus stop is a 10-minute drive away in the Mudon community. Residents can access the Al Salam Community Centre bus stop, which RTA bus F32 serves.

 The nearest station is a 20-minute drive away for those relying on the Dubai Metro. Additionally, Serena is well-connected via significant roads like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, ensuring easy access to other parts of Dubai. Most residents primarily rely on personal vehicles for commuting.

Supermarkets in Serena

Residents of Serena have convenient access to several supermarkets for their daily needs. The Serena Community Centre hosts a supermarket offering a variety of fresh groceries and household essentials. Additionally, there are several supermarkets near Serena for more extensive shopping trips:

  • Carrefour and Geant Express Supermarket in Mudon are popular choices.
  • Choithram offers a selection of imported products, especially from the UK.
  • Spinneys and Al Maya Supermarket in Motor City are just a 15-minute drive from Serena. They provide residents with a wide range of grocery items and daily essentials.

With these options, Serena residents will never face difficulty when it comes to grocery shopping.

Shopping Malls in Serena

While there isn’t a large shopping mall within the Serena community, residents can easily access nearby shopping options. Serena Community Centre is set to become the central retail hub of the community, offering numerous shopping and entertainment facilities once completed. Until then, residents can enjoy retail therapy at nearby malls such as:

  • The Village Community Mall, just an 11-minute drive away, features popular brands like Carrefour and Aster Clinic.
  • The Ranches Souk and Layan Community Centre offers a variety of shopping and dining options.
  • Aramex Locker for convenient package pickups.

Cityland Mall, only a 15-minute drive from Serena, also provides a wide range of retail outlets, dining options, and entertainment facilities. Dubai Outlet Mall is another nearby option for those seeking discounted shopping deals.

Schools and Nurseries in Serena

Families living in Serena have access to a variety of reputable schools and nurseries in the nearby areas. For younger children, several nurseries are conveniently located within a 15-minute drive, including:

  • Step by Step Nursery in Sustainable City, certified by the British Preschool Learning Alliance, offering personalized early learning and childcare.
  • Dibber Nursery in Sustainable City, providing a nurturing environment for toddlers.
  • Blossom Mudon Nursery in Al Salam Town Centre offers young children a safe and enriching experience.

For older children, there are several excellent schools nearby:

  • Fairgreen International School: Just a 15-minute drive, offering a high international education standard.
  • GEMS Metropole School: Also within 15 minutes, following the National Curriculum of England, offering education from Foundation Stage to Post16, and rated ‘Acceptable’ by KHDA.
  • GEMS Vertus School: Another nearby option, known for its quality education and facilities.

These schools and nurseries make Serena an ideal community for families with children of all ages, ensuring access to top-tier education and childcare facilities.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and near Serena Location

Muslim residents in Serena have convenient access to mosques for daily prayers. Masjid Salam, the nearest mosque, is just a 12-minute drive away. Additionally, mosques in the neighboring communities of Mudon, Arabian Ranches, and Sustainable City are easily accessible.

For Christian residents, St. Gregorios Orthodox Church and the International Nepalese Community Church are around a 15-minute drive from Serena.

 Those practicing Sikhism can visit the Gurunanak Darbar Sikh Gurudwara, located in Jebel Ali, approximately a 30-minute drive away.

Other places of worship, such as St. Mary's Catholic Church and Hindu Temple Bur Dubai, are within a 30-minute drive from Serena, ensuring residents of all faiths can access their religious institutions.

Clinics and Hospitals in and near Serena Area

Healthcare facilities near Serena include Mediclinic Parkview Hospital, about a 15-minute drive from the community. Aster Clinic and Emirates Hospital are also nearby, providing various medical services. Serena residents have easy access to high-quality healthcare options, ensuring peace of mind in case of medical emergencies.

Serena Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

  • Proximity to Major Areas: Serena is located near crucial residential areas such as Arabian Ranches and Mudon, offering a family-friendly environment.
  • Distance to Downtown Dubai: Approximately a 25-minute drive to the bustling heart of Downtown Dubai, home to iconic landmarks like Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall.
  • Close to Dubai Marina: A 20-minute drive to Dubai Marina, a popular destination for waterfront living, dining, and leisure activities.
  • Accessibility to Dubai International Airport: About a 30-minute drive to Dubai International Airport, making travel convenient for residents.
  • Strategic Location: Serena's location offers easy access to major roads and critical areas, making it a highly desirable residential community in Dubai.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Serena Area

data.answer:
Serena offers residents a wide range of recreational activities. From outdoor activities to dining and shopping, there is always something to do in and around the community.

Serena Dubai Restaurants

The Serena Community Centre offers several dining options for residents, including cafes and casual eateries. For those craving specific cuisines, nearby options include:

  • Tuk Tuk Thai Cuisine Restaurant: A 10-minute drive from Serena, offering authentic Thai dishes.
  • 800 Pizza and Bagels & More are both within a 10-minute drive, perfect for pizza and bagel lovers.
  • Carluccio’s: Situated in The Ranches Souk, serving continental breakfast and Italian dishes.
  • Abatjour Bistro, Subway, and Zaatar w Zeit are all within a 12-minute drive and offer a variety of bistro-style meals, sandwiches, and Middle Eastern cuisine.

Residents can easily visit neighboring communities such as Mudon and Arabian Ranches for even more dining options.

Beaches Near Serena

While Serena is inland, residents can enjoy a day at the beach by driving 30 minutes to Jumeirah Beach or Kite Beach, two of Dubai’s most popular beach destinations. These beaches offer pristine sands, clear waters, and a range of water sports and recreational activities for families and individuals alike.

Hotels in Serena Area

Serena is surrounded by several prestigious hotels and hotel apartments, offering luxurious amenities and convenient lodging options for visitors and family members of residents. Some of the most recommended hotels near Serena include:

  • Studio One Hotel: This popular choice is located within a 20-minute drive and offers modern amenities and stylish accommodations.
  • Atana Hotel Dubai: Known for its comfort and excellent service, it is ideal for business and leisure travelers.
  • Park Inn by Radisson Dubai: A high-end hotel offering top-notch facilities and proximity to major attractions.
  • The S Hotel: Offering luxury accommodations with fitness and dining options for guests.

These hotels are well-equipped with dining options, fitness centers, and other luxury services, making them ideal for a relaxing stay near Serena.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Serena is designed for those who enjoy outdoor activities. Numerous parks, jogging tracks, and cycling paths are available within the community. The Serena Community Centre also features fitness facilities and beauty salons, ensuring residents can stay active and indulge in wellness treatments.

Community Events

Serena hosts various community events throughout the year, fostering a strong sense of community among residents. From festive celebrations to fitness events, there’s always something happening within the community. These events provide excellent opportunities for families to bond and for neighbors to connect.

Serena Attractions and Landmarks

While Serena is a peaceful residential area, it is close to several attractions. Global Village, a popular entertainment destination, is just a 15-minute drive from Serena. It offers shopping, dining, and cultural experiences. IMG Worlds of Adventure, the world’s largest indoor theme park, is also nearby, providing a thrilling day out for families.

Outdoor Activities, Gyms, and Salons

Serena residents can access several outdoor gyms and fitness areas within the community. The Serena Community Centre is also home to beauty and grooming salons. For those who enjoy staying active, the community’s parks and jogging tracks offer plenty of opportunities for exercise.

Serena Dubai is a premium residential community that caters to families seeking a tranquil yet luxurious lifestyle. While the community is a little further from central Dubai, the peaceful environment, modern amenities, and excellent connectivity make up for it.

Serena Dubai is known for its Mediterranean-inspired architecture, lush green landscapes, and tranquil environment, making it an ideal choice for families seeking an upscale, peaceful lifestyle.

Serena offers a range of residential properties, including 2- to 4-bedroom villas and townhouses. These properties feature spacious interiors, private gardens, and modern amenities.

Serena Dubai properties have flexible floor plans, offering open-plan living areas, large bedrooms, and private outdoor spaces suitable for families of different sizes.

The Serena Community Centre offers various dining options, including cafes and casual eateries. Nearby restaurants include Tuk Tuk Thai Cuisine, 800 Pizza, and Carluccio’s.

The Serena community offers residents luxurious amenities such as landscaped parks, swimming pools, fitness centers, and easy access to schools, supermarkets, and dining options, ensuring a premium lifestyle.

The starting price for 2-bedroom townhouses in Serena is around AED 1.3 million, while 3-bedroom townhouses are priced from AED 1.6 million. Villas have average sales prices of AED 2,046,000 for 2-bedroom units and AED 2,705,000 for 3-bedroom units.

Are there schools and nurseries near Serena?

Yes, several reputable schools and nurseries are located near Serena, including GEMS Metropole School, Fairgreen International School, and Blossom Mudon Nursery, all within a 15-minute drive.

What outdoor activities and recreational facilities are available in Serena?

Serena offers a variety of outdoor activities, including parks, jogging tracks, and cycling paths. The community also has swimming pools, fitness centers, and beauty salons to promote a healthy lifestyle.

The community features vast open spaces, landscaped parks, playgrounds, and jogging tracks that promote a healthy and active lifestyle. Residents also enjoy access to swimming pools, fitness centers, and recreational facilities. The serene environment and modern amenities make Serena one of Dubai's best family-friendly residential communities.

Serena Dubai properties are built with modern amenities, making them ideal for residents who value comfort, convenience, and an active lifestyle. Explore Serena floor plans, recreational activities, and a host of amenities that make Serena a top choice for homebuyers and investors alike.
